title: A lane's pass claim on a PR names the PR's GitHub check state on that head, read once, or the report is refused
why: A lane told the owner "no failure" on #2552 after reading only the local lane lint; the PR's run (windows-latest) check was red (hooks/test_mail.py 3 of 38 failed on Windows). The lane lint runs Linux checks only.
note: Filed by triage 12:47 CST Nov 10 from the messaging topic session (session_013NEJL1YBVqsXRPBac7nRcz, lane on #2552, step mail-send-no-file), owner-prompted 12:46 CST ("seems like useful feedback for how we operate"). Guard: the report check reads the PR's check runs once (get_check_runs on the named head) before a pass claim. Cost: one GitHub read per pass claim. Second note: the Windows run was the first run of hooks/test_mail.py on Windows; RoundTrip and TakeRace on main may fail there too (push to the file:// test store). Unmeasured on main. hooks/mail.py reason() kept only git's last error line; #2552's head 98d0a1c0e keeps the cause line.
